_comment: TypeScript seed (typescriptlang.org/tsconfig). Installed by Coast as the base a project's tsconfig.json extends; yours to edit. C-1 (Web, React Native) names tsc:strict: strict is on, which turns on noImplicitAny, strictNullChecks and the rest of the strict family (typescriptlang.org/tsconfig/#strict); noImplicitAny is also named on its own so it stays on even if strict is ever loosened. The type-checked ESLint config beside this file (eslint.config.mjs) reads the project through TypeScript's project service, so this file and the project's tsconfig.json are the one type source.
